## Checklist

- [ ] The change belongs to the version being built (see `ROADMAP.md`); no feature from a later version.
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `./mvnw verify` passes locally (JDK 21 also checks formatting).
- [ ] Public API changes have Javadoc and are listed in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Security impact considered (template names, resources, escaping, limits, error messages).
- [ ] Significant technical decision recorded as an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
